tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rigs drug sa bon sreg sbyong ni/ 1$0000300rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// lus nang rtsa gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnas drug rigs drug sa bon ni// a su nṛ tri pre du drug /'bru gsum dag pa ye shes mes// rigs drug sa bon thul gyis bsregs// de mthar phaṭa drug brjod pa yis// 'og sgor thal ba bun bun gtor// de rjes yig brgya'i chu rgyun gyis// dri ma cha shas bcas te bkrus// rang lus dri med shel sgong ltar// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i skur gyur bsam// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ko ling sa manta/ zhes 'di ngag bcad bdun 'bum bzlas// rtags ni nyi zla shar ba dang*// shel bum rdo rje nor bu rnyed// gangs ri me tog dkar po rmis// mdor na rtag tu bsgom bzlas na// rigs drug gnas sbyong sdig sgrib dag /sku gsum sa la sangs rgyas 'gyur// 'di ni rang bzo rtog ge min// bcu bdun klong gsal 'das rjes dang*// sras gcig rgyud nas phyung nas bkod// des na phyi rabs 'dir brtson 'os// 'di bris dge bas 'gro phan shog /'di dang rdor sems sgrub pa gnyis// sbrags nas nyams su 'bad blangs na// dag par mi 'gyur sdig sgrib med// rigs drug skye sgo nges par chod// de skad rig 'dzin rol rdor gyi// slob mas dmar ser kā shi'i ras// rten bcas bskul ngor rgyal khams pa// sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bus smras// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
